lines.en: I beat my wings and fly very lightly.
There's dust on my wings. It comes off.

lines.zh: 我绕过屋檐，往花那边去。
lines.en: I round the eaves and head for the flowers.
I fly low, just over the grass.

lines.zh: 黄白色的身子，不太显眼。
lines.en: This pale yellow body doesn't stand out much.
I settle on a flower, then rise again.

lines.zh: 我扇得很慢，晨光里正好。
lines.en: I beat slowly, right for the morning light.
I fly along the wall, looking for a way out.

lines.zh: 我拐了个弯，避开蜘蛛网。
lines.en: I turn aside to miss a web.
I cross the vegetable plot and smell the flowers.
My body is heavy and I can't fly fast.

lines.zh: 我绕着一朵红郁金香转。
lines.en: I circle a red tulip.
My wings make a very small breeze.
I stop on the fence to rest.
I rise a little, then settle.
I head for the other end of the village.
I sit in the flower's heart and draw slowly.
My wings close up like a leaf.
I lift a foreleg and wash my face.

lines.zh: 花粉沾在我身上，黄黄的。
lines.en: Pollen is stuck to me, yellow.
The wind comes and I grip the petal.
I don't move much at night.

lines.zh: 我身上有一层细细的绒。
lines.en: There's a fine fuzz all over me.

lines.zh: 晨光一照，我的翅膀变亮了。
lines.en: In the morning light my wings brighten.
I'm waiting for the sun to rise a little.
A bee passes. I move aside.

lines.zh: 我的茧还挂在那边树上。
lines.en: My cocoon still hangs in that tree.

lines.zh: 我不记得在里面待了多久。
lines.en: I don't remember how long I was inside it.

lines.zh: 你的手，比我的翅膀大得多。
lines.en: Your hand is much bigger than my wings.
You're watching me. I'm on a flower.
I'm not afraid of people, and I keep my distance.

lines.zh: 你要抓我吗？我有网的味道。
lines.en: Are you going to catch me? I smell a net.
I take off and circle halfway.
I settle back where I was and look at you.

lines.zh: 我身上有花粉，你闻得到。
lines.en: There's pollen on me. You can smell it.
I know this village.
Hold still. I'll land on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我翅膀上的粉，会留在你衣服上。
lines.en: My wing dust will stay on your clothes.
I've lost some of my dust.
I fly crooked and come down.
There's a small tear in my wing.
I flutter and lift myself.
The pain stops my flying.
I hide under a leaf.
The pattern on my wings is smeared.
I'm alive. I can still fly.
But not steadily.
I need a flower to rest on.
I see that red flower.
Sweetness, coming from over there.

lines.zh: 我落在花瓣上慢慢吸蜜。
lines.en: I settle on the petal and sip.
The flower you're holding isn't fully open.
Don't pinch it. The petals will bruise.
I circle once before settling.
That's the smell of tulip.
I drink a long while before lifting my head.
I'll stay a little longer.
Will you leave this flower standing?

lines.zh: 我撞在你的手上，掉了几粒粉。
lines.en: I hit your hand and shed a few grains of dust.

lines.zh: 我被撞得歪了一下，又稳住。
lines.en: The bump tips me, then I steady.
I fall to the ground and lift off again.
That bent a corner of my wing.
Your breath blew me aside.

lines.zh: 我的茧，能抽出一整根丝。
lines.en: One cocoon of mine yields a single thread.
I withdraw and light on the fence.

lines.zh: 撞完我在原地转了两圈。
lines.en: Afterward I circle twice on the spot.

lines.zh: 你衣袖沾走了我的鳞粉。
lines.en: Your sleeve took my wing dust.
We part and neither is hurt.
There's another one by the candlelight.
We circle the same flower.
Its wings are a little whiter than mine.
I chase it through one circle.
We settle on a leaf.
The eggs will stick to the underside.
One leaf, several dozen.
I won't watch over them.
They'll eat and grow on their own.
We only have a few days left.

lines.zh: 我用前足捧起一点花蜜。
lines.en: I cup a little nectar with my forelegs.
That mouthful is faintly sweet.

lines.zh: 我把口器伸进去，慢慢吸。
lines.en: I push my proboscis in and draw slowly.
Pollen sticks to my legs.
This flower has little nectar.
I move to another and go on.
It's at its peak.
I've drunk, and the flower is still a flower.
I carry the pollen to the next one.
This way more of them will bloom.
There's a patch of red over there.
Tulips, in bloom.
I rise and fly that way.
The wind pushes me off course.
I correct and keep going.
From here it's a few wingbeats.
I pick the reddest one.
No web below it.
I slow and get ready to land.
The reddest one of all.
I circle the flower once.
The petals sway in the wind.
I wait for it to still.
Now I settle.
My proboscis goes in.
The sweetness comes up.
I draw very slowly.
A bee is coming over.
I drift over to the red tulips.
The bee has flown off.
I bump it. Very lightly.
I flap my wings to push it away.
That only scattered some dust.
It hits me and I tumble half around.
I drop and hide under a leaf.
I lift off again and come around behind.
I have no strength for fighting.
I only refuse to give up this flower.
It finally flies off.
I return to the flower and drink again.

lines.zh: 我从茧里挤出来，翅膀是湿的。
lines.en: I push out of the cocoon with wet wings.

lines.zh: 我先挂在茧边，等它们干。
lines.en: I hang by the cocoon and wait for them to dry.
The shell stays behind, empty.
My wings dry and the color comes.
I try one beat.
And then I'm flying.
It's morning in the village.
Flowers, a vegetable plot, a fence.
I'll go to the nearest flower first.
The day is long. Mine isn't.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的翅膀就卷了。
lines.en: The fire curls my wings.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下，摔在土上。
lines.en: I fall from above and hit the dirt.

lines.zh: 水一沾翅膀，我就飞不起来。
lines.en: Water on my wings and I can't fly.

lines.zh: 爆炸的气浪掀翻了我的翅。
lines.en: The blast flipped my wings over.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过去，我的翅尖破了。
lines.en: An arrow grazes past and tears my wingtip.
A light holds me in midair.
The flowers are gone and my belly's empty.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整片翅膀都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning falls and my whole wing lights up.

lines.zh: 没有花，没有风，我一直掉。
lines.en: No flowers, no wind. I keep falling.
